name: United States Virgin Islands
flagName: Flag of the United States Virgin Islands
summary: A white field with a simplified US coat of arms: a yellow eagle holding an olive branch and three arrows, with a shield, between the letters V and I.
origin: The US bought the islands from Denmark in 1917. The flag was designed by Percival Wilson Clement and adopted by the naval governor on 17 May 1921.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The eagle; one of the islands' colours.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The shield's chief and the letters.

symbols.name: Eagle
symbols.description: A yellow eagle with a US shield on its breast.

symbols.name: Olive branch and three arrows
symbols.meaning: Peace, and the three main islands: St Croix, St Thomas and St John.

symbols.name: V and I
symbols.description: Blue letters on either side of the eagle.

facts: The three arrows represent the three main islands.
Before 1917 the islands were the Danish West Indies.
A redesign was proposed in the 2020s, but the 1921 flag remains.
clues: White with a yellow eagle between the letters V and I.
Its eagle holds three arrows for three islands.
Its islands were bought from Denmark in 1917.
